question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains dominant control over the Chinese Communist Party and People's Liberation Army through extensive anti-corruption purges, including the January 2026 investigation of senior military figures such as CMC Vice Chairman Zhang Youxia, which eliminated potential rivals while reinforcing centralized authority. No designated successor has emerged, and elite reshuffling ahead of the 21st Party Congress expected in late 2027 centers on Xi securing a fourth term rather than a leadership transition. His continued public diplomacy, policy direction, and institutional dominance have produced near-unanimous trader consensus that removal before the end of 2026 remains unlikely. Realistic variables that could still alter the outcome include abrupt health developments or elite-level backlash triggered by severe economic or foreign-policy setbacks.

question: Will Gavin Newsom win the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination?
